title: Studio: a `controlled_by_parent` object needs exactly one `master_detail` with `required: true` (objectstack#23100) — the designer writes an omitted `required` that the save door now refuses, and `deriveMasterObject` reads the first master by order
body:
Blocked-by: #12370

Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` names a release built from objectstack `76815b901` or later, i.e. one whose `ObjectSchema` refuses a `controlled_by_parent` object without exactly one `master_detail` declared `required: true`

Filing gate: cross-repo rule 3. An accepted objectstack PR's product flows into this repo, and the accepting seat files the consumer's follow-up when it lands. This card is held (`pm:on-hold`) until the release is installable. Both items were named by that PR's contract review (`6142098559`, the Studio item and item B).

Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader who acts: objectui triage, to route it. The fix lands in `packages/app-shell` (the Studio).

## What landed upstream

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23100 (ruling B, `6134079470`) was carried by PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23179, merged as `76815b901` at 2026-10-13T09:34Z.
- ADR-0055 §1 is now enforced. A `controlled_by_parent` object derives its master from exactly one `master_detail` field declared `required: true`. `ObjectSchema` refuses anything else, at the metadata save door too, with a prescription that names the fix. The runtime's two fallback tiers (any `master_detail`, then a required `lookup`) are retired. An object without exactly one required master has every read denied and every write refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA`.
- A stored row in the shape this repo's Studio writes (one `master_detail` that omits `required`) is converted on load by the D2 `cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted`. A live save in that shape is refused.

## The two readers here, measured at objectui `origin/main` `67ca3af9`

1. **The writer.** The Studio is the measured producer of the omitted-`required` shape:
   - `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/object-fields-io.ts:232` `newField` emits `{ type, label }` with no `required`;
   - `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:992` writes `required: v || undefined`;
   - `studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx:202` offers `controlled_by_parent` on an existing object.

   An author who chooses `controlled_by_parent` while the master's Required toggle is off now meets the save door's refusal. The refusal is loud and names the fix, so it is not a silent trap, but the one writer the D2 exists for keeps writing the shape. The designer forces or prompts `required: true` on the master when `controlled_by_parent` is chosen, and when a `master_detail` is added to such an object. Which of the two is objectui's call.
2. **The display reader.** `studio-design/owd-sharing.ts:67` `deriveMasterObject` returns the `reference` of the FIRST `master_detail` field by order, without reading `required`. `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx:267` shows it. After the upstream change it shows a master for an object the runtime derives none from: a non-required `master_detail`, or two required ones, where the runtime refuses rather than picking by order. It should show the one required `master_detail`, and nothing (the authoring error) otherwise.

## Acceptance

Run on the installed release:

- Choosing `controlled_by_parent` with a non-required master leaves the object savable. The designer sets or prompts `required: true`.
- `deriveMasterObject` agrees with the runtime: one required `master_detail` gives its reference; none, or two or more, gives undefined. Pins cover the three shapes.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `Studio controlled_by_parent master_detail required toggle deriveMasterObject one required master` → 3 hits (#5880, #5940, #4811, all closed, other master-detail questions). None is this.

Dedupe words: controlled_by_parent one required master_detail Studio; deriveMasterObject required; Required toggle omitted required; cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted.
